I need to find out who was the British Prime Minister during King Edward VIII's reign.

King Edward VIII reigned for a very short period in 1936 (January 20 - December 11, 1936), before abdicating. During this time, Stanley Baldwin was the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

Answer: Stanley Baldwin was the only British Prime Minister to hold office during the reign of King Edward VIII.
